function.description: Search file CONTENTS for a regex (gitignore-aware); output_mode 'content' or 'files'. It does not match file names: to find a file by name, set glob (e.g. glob='report.md', pattern='^', output_mode='files'). '(no matches)' means no line matched, not that a file is absent
function.name: coding_grep

glob.description: Filename glob filter on the base name, e.g. '*.py'; to find a file BY NAME use pattern '^', glob 'name.md', output_mode 'files'

path.description: Subdir (relative to workspace) to search; defaults to the whole workspace

pattern.description: Regex matched against file CONTENTS (lines), never against file names
